suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention for rerun UX: 'During section reruns, show prior data at reduced opacity (e.g., opacity-50) alongside a loading indicator, rather than hiding it behind a skeleton. This preserves user context during the operation.'
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: ResearchSection shows skeleton-only during rerun (hiding prior data at research-section.tsx:185), while ContactsSection shows actual contacts at opacity-50 (contacts-section.tsx:155). This inconsistency arose from lack of convention guidance.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention: 'Shared constants used by both client components and server actions should be defined in a shared utility file (e.g., lib/utils/) rather than duplicated.' Specifically, DEFAULT_WEIGHTS should be extracted to lib/utils/scoring.ts.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: DEFAULT_WEIGHTS is duplicated in scoring-section.tsx:37 and lib/actions/briefs.ts:48 with identical values. If weights are updated in one place but not the other, scoring will diverge between the brief page and the API.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update fullstack-worker skill to clarify that agent-browser verification is only required when the feature includes UI components. Backend-only features (data loaders, migrations, repository functions) should skip browser verification.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: fix-migration-and-brief-data-loader worker correctly deviated from the skill by skipping agent-browser since the feature was backend-only. The skill should explicitly acknowledge this case.
